overview: You wrote to Quiney about the town's certificate. Woburn burned on Saturday, and a tract is already in the press. You asked him to send the paper. You set no sum on the letter. You dated it the nineteenth of September 1595. The words were hard, and these are the ones you found.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Wrote the letter, dated it, and left the sum off.

parties.name: Richard Quiney
parties.context: Written to. Not in the room.

parties.name: Richard Field
parties.context: The promise was his, from Wednesday. Not in the room.
